answer: Every identity re-earns its seal each epoch: answer originally AND grade randomly drawn peers, so standing decays unless both keep flowing. Copies die on similarity filters; grading credit flows only to identities whose own work scores well, so reputation cannot be minted in bulk - only earned by sustained two-way labour. Across that meadow, each farmed identity must write with its own quill and judge honestly, while the pool stays capped per epoch: linear cost, bounded gain, and counterfeit jade fails on replay.
